emotion_and_vibe: Warm, welcoming, editorial, high-quality, aesthetic, trust-building.

spacing_and_layout.app_container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FDFCF8] relative shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col
spacing_and_layout.feed_layout: Masonry grid with 2 columns, gap-3 or gap-4. Card heights vary based on image aspect ratio.

onboarding.layout: Full screen image background with deep gradient overlay (black/40 to black/10) to let text pop. Bottom anchored content.
onboarding.button: w-full rounded-full py-4 bg-white text-[#1C1917] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-3 shadow-md

navigation.bottom_tab: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#E7E5DF] flex justify-around items-center h-20 pb-4 pt-2 z-50

category_chips.layout: flex overflow-x-auto gap-3 py-4 px-4 scrollbar-hide sticky top-0 bg-[#FDFCF8]/95 backdrop-blur-md z-40
category_chips.chip_inactive: bg-[#F5F2EC] text-[#57534E] px-5 py-2 rounded-full border border-[#E7E5DF]

masonry_card.container: relative w-full mb-4 break-inside-avoid overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-subtle group
masonry_card.image_overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-80
masonry_card.creator_avatar: absolute bottom-3 left-3 w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 border-white object-cover
masonry_card.title: absolute bottom-3 left-14 right-3 text-white text-sm font-medium line-clamp-2 drop-shadow-md

post_detail.content_card: px-6 py-6 -mt-8 relative bg-[#FDFCF8] rounded-t-3xl z-10
post_detail.action_bar: flex items-center gap-4 border-y border-[#E7E5DF] py-4 my-6

map_view.custom_pin: w-10 h-10 rounded-full border-2 border-white bg-[#B25E46] shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden

interactive_rules.hover_states: Use scale-95 on tap for cards and buttons. Avoid harsh color shifts.
interactive_rules.accessibility: All text over images must have a gradient scrim or text-shadow. Minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1.
interactive_rules.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='tab-home', data-testid='category-food').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a mobile-first web app mimicking React Native Expo behavior (use max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen for the main layout wrapper).
Use react-masonry-css or a CSS columns approach for the Pinterest-style feed on the Home view.
Implement the UI with Shadcn components customized with the provided colors and organic/rounded aesthetics.
Ensure the bottom navigation bar is fixed at the bottom of the container, not the viewport if it exceeds max-w-md.
Use Lucide-react for the bottom tab icons and all internal iconography.
Use the provided image URLs to populate the masonry feed, post details, and creator avatars instead of placeholders.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, tabs, and interactive elements for testing.
